messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(For each entry, the dates shown are the actual holiday date and the adjacent weekend days that form the long weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** (Observed) | Jan 2 (Monday – observed for Sunday, Jan 1) | Dec 31 – Jan 2 |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | Apr 7 – 9 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 24 (Monday) | May 22 – 24 |
| **Canada Day** (Observed) | Jul 3 (Monday – observed for Saturday, Jul 1) | Jul 1 – 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | Sep 2 – 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | Oct 7 – 9 |
| **Remembrance Day** (Observed) | Nov 13 (Monday – observed for Saturday, Nov 11) | Nov 11 – 13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | Dec 23 – 25 |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 27 (Wednesday – observed for Tuesday, Dec 26) | Dec 25 – 27 |

**Provincial/territorial holidays that also create long weekends in 2023**

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|--------------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Prince Edward Island | St. George’s Day | Mar 27 (Monday – observed for Thursday, Mar 23) | Mar 27 – 29 |
| British Columbia | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Manitoba | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Ontario | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Saskatchewan | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Alberta | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| New Brunswick | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Nova Scotia | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Quebec | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Yukon | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Northwest Territories | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Nunavut | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |

> **Note:**  
> * Some provinces observe St. Patrick’s Day on a Monday if the holiday falls on a weekday (e.g., Mar 27 in PEI).  
> * The “Observed” dates above reflect the statutory practice of moving the holiday to the nearest Monday when it falls on a weekend.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the data in a different format (CSV, JSON, etc.) let me know!
